# Key results (generated by code/analysis/b08_key_results.py - do not edit by hand)

Unit of analysis: run = one (dataset, target) pair; 45 runs = 9 datasets x 5 targets (27 vibration, 18 temperature). Operating horizons fixed by the original study before this analysis: vibration h=3 min, temperature h=15 min (cumulative MSE over steps 1..h). Every method is scored at the same 400 origins per run (5 folds x 80).


## Vibration (27 runs, h=3)

- Trained models beating the strongest naive baseline in a majority of runs: 2 of 13 (TiDE 27/27, TimeXer 26/27, TFT 4/27, NHITS 1/27).
- Median skill vs strongest naive (top 8): TiDE +0.222; Ridge-Univariate +0.202; Ridge-Sensors +0.195; AR-Local +0.171; ChronosBolt-Small +0.161; Chronos2 +0.159; TimeXer +0.085; Ensemble-Mean-13 +0.058.
- Ensemble-Mean-13 vs TiDE: median MSE ratio 1.240, method better in 0/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=1.5e-08 (Holm 6.6e-07).
- Ensemble-Mean-13 vs median trained model: median MSE ratio 0.704, method better in 27/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=1.5e-08 (Holm 6.6e-07).
- Ridge-Univariate vs TiDE: median MSE ratio 1.024, method better in 6/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=0.0013 (Holm 0.01).
- Ridge-Univariate vs median trained model: median MSE ratio 0.580, method better in 27/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=1.5e-08 (Holm 6.6e-07).
- Ridge-Sensors vs TiDE: median MSE ratio 1.048, method better in 2/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=0.00016 (Holm 0.0016).
- Ridge-Sensors vs median trained model: median MSE ratio 0.600, method better in 27/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=1.5e-08 (Holm 6.6e-07).
- ChronosBolt-Small vs TiDE: median MSE ratio 1.094, method better in 3/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=6.3e-05 (Holm 0.0007).
- ChronosBolt-Small vs median trained model: median MSE ratio 0.624, method better in 27/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=1.5e-08 (Holm 6.6e-07).
- Chronos2 vs TiDE: median MSE ratio 1.093, method better in 4/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=5.5e-05 (Holm 0.00069).
- Chronos2 vs median trained model: median MSE ratio 0.616, method better in 27/27 runs, Wilcoxon p=1.5e-08 (Holm 6.6e-07).
- Causal recalibration 'shrink' of the 13 trained models (folds 2-5): median MSE ratio 0.941, improved in 19/27 runs, p=0.062.
- Causal recalibration 'affine' of the 13 trained models (folds 2-5): median MSE ratio 0.962, improved in 20/27 runs, p=0.041.
- Causal recalibration 'anchored' of the 13 trained models (folds 2-5): median MSE ratio 0.709, improved in 27/27 runs, p=1.5e-08.
- Anchored recalibration, scope: TiDE alone 1.008 (improved in 7/27 runs); Ridge-Univariate alone 1.012. After recalibration, trained models beating raw Ridge-Univariate (folds 2-5) in a majority of runs: TiDE 21/27. Best recalibrated trained model per run, picked with hindsight on the test folds: 0.990x ridge, better in 21/27 runs.
- Overconfidence sd_ratio/r of trained models (median over runs): 1.11 (TiDE) to 3.57 (TSMixerx).
